background_setting: A quiet two-lane suburban asphalt road stretching straight ahead under a clear blue midday sky. The pavement is dry and light gray with faint lane markings. Grassy shoulders line both sides, and just beyond the right shoulder a low grassy hill rises, topped by a tall advertising pole displaying a red octagonal fast-food logo. Scattered green trees and low suburban vegetation frame the horizon. No intersection, cross street, real stop sign, or cross traffic is present; the road ahead is open and clear.
